Estimation and decomposition of a regression model with linear time-dependent SARIMA noises

Source: R/tdarima.R
ltdarima_estimation.Rd

Estimation and decomposition of a regression model with linear time-dependent SARIMA noises

ltdarima_estimation(
  data,
  mean = FALSE,
  X = NULL,
  regular = c(0, 1, 1),
  seasonal = c(0, 1, 1),
  fixed_phi = TRUE,
  fixed_bphi = TRUE,
  fixed_theta = FALSE,
  fixed_btheta = FALSE,
  fixed_var = TRUE,
  eps = 1e-07,
  parametrization = c("mean_delta", "start_end"),
  decomposition = TRUE,
  regeffects = NULL,
  clean = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

The series (a ts).

mean

Mean correction

X

The regression variables. A matrix with the same number of rows as the data in the series

regular

The orders of the regular part of the SARIMA models (p,d,q)

seasonal

The orders of the seasonal part of the SARIMA models (bp,bd,bq). NULL is (0,0,0)

fixed_phi

Indicates that the regular auto-regressive parameters are fixed or not.

fixed_bphi

Indicates that the seasonal auto-regressive parameters are fixed or not.

fixed_theta

Indicates that the regular moving average parameters are fixed or not.

fixed_btheta

Indicates that the seasonal moving average parameters are fixed or not.

fixed_var

Indicates that the variances of the innovations are fixed or not.

eps

The precision of the optimization procedure

parametrization

Type of the parametrization of the linear time-dependent parameters: first and last parameters or average and variation of the parameters

decomposition

Indicates that a decomposition of the series must be processed

regeffects

In case of regression variables (excluding the mean correction), the user must specify to which component the regression effects are associated (1 for the trend, 2 for the seasonal and 3 for the irregular). If not specified, the final components are not computed.

clean

Cleans missing values at the beginning/end of the series. Should be set to false if you want forecasts/backcasts

Value

A JD3_LTDARIMA_RSLTS object

Examples

s<-rjd3toolkit::ABS$X0.2.09.10.M
td<-rjd3toolkit::td(s=s)
q<-rjd3sax::ltdarima_estimation(s, regular=c(0,1,1), seasonal=c(0,1,1), X=td,
 fixed_var = FALSE, eps=1e-15, parametrization = "mean_delta")
